packageRules.description: Keep pnpm on the supported 10.x line until the runtime toolchain is upgraded deliberately
Group and automerge updates that preserve the declared compatibility range

github.com/google/uuid v1.6.0 is the current release and resolves normally through the Go proxy, but Renovate's hosted Go lookup intermittently reports no-result. Disable only this false-positive lookup; all other Go module updates remain enabled.

This mirror lives on a LAN-only registry (docker-registry.lan.jlapenna.net) that Renovate's runner cannot reach or authenticate to, so digest lookups always fail here. The image is already pinned deliberately and updated by hand per the instructions in apps/runner-autoscaler/runner-image/Dockerfile — disable Renovate for it rather than have it keep filing the same unfixable lookup-failure warning.

Same LAN-only-registry unreachability as the mirror rule above, now also true of apps/telemetry-watcher/deploy/docker-compose.yml's own image reference (that file moved here from jlapenna/homelab in homelab#218 Phase 6; homelab's own renovate.json covered it there under a blanket docker-registry.lan.jlapenna.net/** exclusion this repo doesn't have). Updated by hand on pike via deploy/deploy.sh after canonical homelab publication.
